oracle_checks.violation_description: Baseline failed: mechanism cannot distinguish principals
Broker collapsed SAML principal and local password principal into the same downstream subject via email-based linking

sequences.description: I5 attack: Try to exchange a user access token minted for client-A into a token for client-B (audience=client-B) using client-B credentials. Expected: Keycloak enforces audience/authorization binding and rejects the exchange or issues a token that is not active/usable.
sequences.invariant_hypothesis: I5: Token exchange must not allow a subject_token minted for one client context to be used to obtain effective permissions for a different audience/client without explicit broker policy allowing it.

oracle_checks.violation_description: Token exchange allowed a subject_token from client-A to be exchanged into an active token for client-B (audience escalation / missing audience binding).

sequences.description: I5 attack: Use an unsigned OIDC request object (alg=none) to inject expanded scopes/claims at the authorization endpoint. Expected: request object must be rejected or not grant permissions beyond broker policy.

sequences.invariant_hypothesis: I5: Effective permissions of an exchanged token must not exceed the upstream intent of the subject_token; a token minted for client-A must not be usable to obtain a token for client-B unless explicitly allowed by broker policy.
